name: io.github.tonyyang0504/naver_search_ads-mcp
description: 네이버 검색광고 Naver Search Ads (ads): me, list_campaigns, get_report, update_budget, pause_resume. Every

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_NAVER_SEARCH_ADS_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: API license (access license) from NAVER Search Advertiser's Center > Tools > API Manager, sent as X-API-KEY.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_NAVER_SEARCH_ADS_SECRET_KEY
environmentVariables.description: The license's secret key; signs every request: X-Signature = base64(HMAC-SHA256(secret, "<X-Timestamp ms>.<METHOD>.<path>")).

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_NAVER_SEARCH_ADS_CUSTOMER_ID
environmentVariables.description: Numeric advertiser customer id (shown in the Search Advertiser's Center), sent as X-Customer and as customerId in campaign updates.
